metadata.scenario: A client calls with concerns about being overcharged for a service and requests clarification and adjustment. Category: Billing. Flags: billing_dispute.

transcription.text: Thank you for calling CareFirst Home Health, this is Margaret speaking. How can I assist you today? Hi, Margaret. This is Patricia Wilson. I'm calling because I have some concerns about my mother’s billing for her post-surgery care. Of course, Patricia. I'm sorry to hear that. Can you tell me more about the issue? Well, I noticed that we were charged more than I expected for the skilled nursing care services. I understand. Let me check the details of your mother's account. Can you please provide me her full name? Yes, her name is Eleanor Wilson. She’s scheduled for post-surgery care after her hip replacement. Thank you, Patricia. I’m pulling up her records now. Just a moment, please. Alright, I have her billing details here. It looks like she was charged for three visits of skilled nursing care at $120 each. Is that the amount you were questioning? Yes, that’s it! I thought the service was quoted at a lower range. I was expecting it to be around $95 to $125 per visit. I see how that could be confusing. The $120 is on the higher end of our pricing, which can vary based on care needs. I understand, but I really need to ensure that we’re not being overcharged, especially since she’ll need ongoing care. Absolutely. Let me review the specifics of the services provided and see if adjustments can be made. That would be great. I’m on a tight budget with all the expenses related to her surgery. I completely understand. I’ll take a deeper look and see if there were any billing errors or if adjustments are appropriate. While I do that, are there additional services you might be interested in? Our companion care could help as well. I hadn’t thought about that, but it could be useful for her recovery. Companion care is priced at $25 to $30 per hour and can provide valuable support during recovery. That sounds reasonable. I’ll consider adding that service. Great! I'll follow up with the billing issue and also send you more information about companion care. Thank you, Margaret. I appreciate your help with this. You're welcome, Patricia. I’ll call you within 24 hours with an update on the billing. Sounds good! I’ll be waiting for your call. Thank you for your patience. Have a great day! You too, goodbye! Goodbye!
